Container.Name: Phonon TTS
Container.Overview:
Phonon TTS runs Gradium's Phonon text-to-speech models and serves an OpenAI-compatible speech API (POST /v1/audio/speech), so any client with an "OpenAI TTS" setting and a custom base URL works unchanged. It can also serve the Wyoming protocol, which Home Assistant uses for local voice. It runs entirely on the CPU and is fast: Gradium's models speak faster than real time even on a Raspberry Pi.
Language: PTTS_LANG is required and picks how numbers and symbols are spelled out, and which catalog voices are served; it must match the language of the checkpoint (en by default; fr for a French model, and so on).
First start: downloads the default model and the voices for its language into the cache folder, and logs little until they load; watch the log. The cache folder keeps them across restarts and updates, so later starts go straight to serving.
Home Assistant: set PTTS_WYOMING_ADDR to 0.0.0.0:10200 and map the Wyoming port too; then add the Wyoming Protocol integration in Home Assistant with this server's address and port 10200.
Access: the API has NO authentication on either port. Use it on a network you trust; do not expose it to the internet.
Other models: leave Model empty for the built-in default, or name a Hugging Face repo as hf://owner/name (add @commit for a fixed version). The Phonon 40M models are gated: accept their terms on Hugging Face first and set an HF token here.
Template and Unraid problems: the Support link. Phonon and the server itself: the Project link.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: tts text to speech voice audio openai wyoming home assistant local voice assistant gradium rdna cpu
Container.Requires: **No authentication** — the API ports are open to anything that can reach them; run on a trusted network only. The first start downloads the model and voices (well under 1 GB) into the cache folder, which must persist. CPU only: no GPU or driver plugin needed; quantized weights (q8) do not use a GPU even when one is present.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: The OpenAI-compatible speech API (POST /v1/audio/speech, GET /v1/audio/voices, GET /health). No authentication — do not expose this port beyond your network.

Config.Name: Wyoming port
Config.Description: Home Assistant's Wyoming protocol. Only used when PTTS_WYOMING_ADDR is set below; leave this port empty if you do not use Home Assistant.

Config.Name: Model and voices cache
Config.Description: Where the model, voices and any HF downloads live (under about 1 GB). Persists across restarts, template edits and updates; deleting it means re-downloading on the next start.

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Required. Spelling out of numbers and symbols, and which catalog voices are served. Must match the checkpoint's language: en, fr, es, de, pt for the Phonon checkpoints, plus more normalization-only codes (see the README). In YAML contexts nb is the safe code for Norwegian.

Config.Name: Ignore speed
Config.Description: true: accept the speed parameter that OpenAI clients always send, and speak at the normal rate anyway. Keep it true unless your client needs real speed control.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Empty: the built-in default model. Or a Hugging Face repo as hf://owner/name — add @commit_sha to pin the version (without it, the repo's main branch is used and updates flow in). Phonon 40M models are gated: accept their Hugging Face terms first and set the HF token below.

Config.Name: HF token
Config.Description: Only for gated or private Hugging Face repos (the Phonon 40M models). Get one at huggingface.co/settings/tokens.

Config.Name: Quantization
Config.Description: Checkpoint weight format. q8 is the recommended CPU default and runs on the CPU even when a GPU is present.

Config.Name: OpenAI voice names
Config.Description: Set to default (or one of your voices) to also accept OpenAI's own voice names (alloy, nova, ...) — handy for clients with a fixed voice list. Empty: only this server's real voices.

Config.Name: Voice aliases
Config.Description: Extra names, comma-separated, like nova=VOICE. The named voice must exist or the server does not start.

Config.Name: Wyoming address
Config.Description: Set to 0.0.0.0:10200 to also serve Home Assistant's Wyoming protocol (map the Wyoming port above). Home Assistant then lists Phonon as a text-to-speech engine.

Config.Name: Voice catalog
Config.Description: Empty: Gradium's public voice catalog (gradium/phonon-voices) for your language. Set to hf://owner/name[@revision], or a path inside the container to your own voices.jsonl, to use different voices.
